name: Ye Toh Tatti Hai
visual_description: A bald goon peers over the shoulder of another henchman looking into a box with disgust, subtitled 'Ye toh tatti hai'.
usage_context: Used to express extreme disappointment, disgust, or pointing out that something hyped or received is completely worthless or garbage.

example.top_caption: Me looking at my semester exam results after studying all night

text_areas.description: Situation leading to receiving or discovering something completely terrible
